title: sideritis hirsuta subsp. nivalis
intro: Sideritis hirsuta subsp. nivalis, commonly known as Mountain Tea of the Balkans, is a subspecies of the Sideritis hirsuta plant, a type of flowering plant in the mint family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Tea of the Balkans are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic agent, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
